    Compact and algebraic closed-set lattices #

    For a finitary closure operator, point closures are compact. Consequently the closed-set lattice is compactly generated (algebraic), and compact closed sets have finite extreme-point bases.

    source
    theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.pointClosure_isCompactElement {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (x : E) :
    IsCompactElement (c.pointClosure x)

    Finitarity makes every point closure a compact element of the closed-set lattice.

    source
    theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.finiteClosure_isCompactElement {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} (hfin : c.IsFinitary) {B : Set E} (hBfin : B.Finite) :
    IsCompactElement (ClosureOperator.toCloseds c B)

    The closure of a finite set is a compact element of the closed-set lattice.

    source

      source
      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.finiteClosuresBelow_directed_sSup {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (C : ClosureOperator.Closeds c) :
      (c.finiteClosuresBelow C).Nonempty ∧ DirectedOn (fun (x1 x2 : ClosureOperator.Closeds c) => x1 ≤ x2) (c.finiteClosuresBelow C) ∧ (∀ K ∈ c.finiteClosuresBelow C, IsCompactElement K) ∧ sSup (c.finiteClosuresBelow C) = C

      Every closed set is the directed supremum of the closures of its finite subsets. Under finitarity, all members of this directed family are compact.

      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.isCompactlyGenerated_closeds {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} (hfin : c.IsFinitary) :
      IsCompactlyGenerated (ClosureOperator.Closeds c)

      The closed-set lattice of a finitary closure operator is compactly generated; this is the equidistribution paper's algebraicity assertion.

      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.exists_finite_generator_of_isCompactElement {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} {C : ClosureOperator.Closeds c} (hcompact : IsCompactElement C) :
      ∃ (B : Set E), B.Finite ∧ B ⊆ ↑C ∧ c B = ↑C

      A compact closed set is generated by finitely many of its points.

      source
      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.isCompactElement_iff_exists_finite_generator {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} (hfin : c.IsFinitary) {C : ClosureOperator.Closeds c} :
      IsCompactElement C ↔ ∃ (B : Set E), B.Finite ∧ B ⊆ ↑C ∧ c B = ↑C

      For a finitary closure operator, compact closed sets are exactly the closures of finite subsets. The generator can always be chosen inside the closed set.

      source
      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.exists_finite_isMinimalGenerator {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} {B C : Set E} (hBfin : B.Finite) (hBC : c B = C) :
      ∃ (B₀ : Set E), B₀.Finite ∧ B₀ ⊆ B ∧ c.IsMinimalGenerator B₀ C

      A finite generating set contains an inclusion-minimal finite generating subset, without assuming that the entire ground type is finite.

      source
      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.finite_minimalGenerator_eq_extremePoints {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange) {B C : Set E} (hC : c.IsClosed C) (hB : c.IsMinimalGenerator B C) :
      B = c.extremePoints C

      In the finitary setting, every finite minimal generator is the extreme-point set, even when the ambient ground type is infinite.

      source
      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.compact_extremePoints_basis {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange) {C : ClosureOperator.Closeds c} (hcompact : IsCompactElement C) :
      (c.extremePoints ↑C).Finite ∧ c.IsMinimalGenerator (c.extremePoints ↑C) ↑C

      A compact closed set in a finitary convex geometry has a finite extreme-point set, and that set is its unique minimal generator.

      source
      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.SetClosure.compact_isMinimalGenerator_iff_eq_extremePoints {E : Type u_1} {c : SetClosure E} (hfin : c.IsFinitary) (hae : c.IsAntiExchange) {C : ClosureOperator.Closeds c} (hcompact : IsCompactElement C) {B : Set E} :
      c.IsMinimalGenerator B ↑C ↔ B = c.extremePoints ↑C

      For a compact closed set in a finitary convex geometry, a set is a minimal generator exactly when it is the extreme-point set. In particular, the minimal basis asserted above is unique.
